real_font_smoke.method: 52 ASCII letters, a common Han phrase where mapped, and first 3-4 mapped codepoints among first 50 per Extension A and supplementary Han block; 20pt stroked polygon and filled Bezier PDF -> persisted DXF -> TEXT; source font copy removed before conversion

saved_output_audit.method: Each published glyph label/source handles and bbox checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen excluding move-only contours without any segments at the PDF generation position; original DXF entity tags compared to rc22 in all cases after removing only recovery layer/XDATA. No source fonts used by runtime matching.

remaining_limits.reason: Jigmo common Han stroke/fill: 廴 is near parent height and 囗 has identical parent bounds; remain ambiguous.

fill_repair.method: Extract Polygon parts recursively from repaired GeometryCollection while retaining source ring orientation; zero-area lines have no fill and separately requested strokes remain.

real_font_smoke.catalog_selection: Each PDF uses the single font-face catalog matching its generating font; not all ten catalogs together.

font_representations.method: Every raw template equals the legacy published template record, including topology, masks, aspect and all sampling digests. Every new fill alternate verified against the original pinned font using an independent closed-polygon convex-hull-area-zero oracle, across all 17 sampling divisors. Source fonts used only for offline audit.

additional_digit_probes.runtime: rc23 with unchanged r2 catalogs; original rc21 PDFs reused

han_fragment_resolution.method: Read persisted candidate evidence without calling overlap resolver; verify actual DXF handles/bounds, strict containment, independent anchor labels, height ratios, and exact masks/topology against unchanged r2 catalogs. Published parent bounds/labels are separately checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen.

historical_rc22_catalog_selection.runtime: isolated installed wheel (-I); catalogs from downloaded r2 bundles

source_catalog_selection.runtime: source runtime with normal uncached resource loading; catalogs from downloaded r2 bundles

all_ten_catalog_regression.method: Reset recovery metadata on copies of the 84 persisted rc22 font DXFs. Execute frozen rc22 and current rc23 full DXF recognizers with all ten downloaded r2 catalogs; cache only validated catalog objects to avoid repeated disk parsing. Independent PDF and installed-wheel checks exercise uncached resource loading. These are targeted 20pt samples, not universal-font accuracy.

saved_output_audit.method: All-ten-catalog DXF recovery: each published glyph label/source handles and bbox checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen excluding move-only contours without any segments at the PDF generation position; original DXF entity tags compared to rc22 in all cases after removing only recovery layer/XDATA. No source fonts used by runtime matching.

row_recheck_evidence.method: Independently enumerate every proper source-atom window inside each restored parent. Recompute original exact mask/topology variants against all ten unchanged catalogs, and compare the complete set of candidate font/label pairs to recorded conflicts. Verify globally unique parent and three anchor labels, actual source handles/bounds, containment, fragment-height ratios and continuous source sequence. Does not call the new recheck/overlap resolver. Original font cmap/BoundsPen audit separately checks output labels and positions.
